newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins fall on new issue rumours.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins fall on new issue rumours.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds fell on rumours new bonds of the fourth tranche would be issued, and the market was also overshadowed by the possible freezing of further bonds, dealers said.
Finance ministry officials were not immediately available for comment.
Banking sources told Reuters last Friday the Russian police may freeze up to a further $7 million nominal of MinFin bonds which have been stolen.
"Trading has been thin since Monday because of another possible freezing and the recent rumours (about a new issue) are just reinforcing the downward trend," one dealer said.
He added the market was not active ahead of the longer U.S. Labor Day weekend.
Imperial Bank dealer Andrei Bakin said both foreign and Moscow operators were selling in thin trading.
"Amounts are tiny and these (new issue) rumours look like speculative selling by people who want to close positions they have opened before," he added.
